label: Ukko system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Ukko locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Ukko branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual UkkA, UkkB, UkkC, and UkkD genes, UkkA, UkkB, UkkC, and UkkD proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Ukko locus, unresolved Ukko trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
